competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times and decreases the Attack Power for 2 turns with a 35% chance with each attack.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 3 times and leaves a Branding effect for 2 turns with a 75% chance each. The cooldown time of [Time of Destruction] will be decreased by 1 turn each whenever you attack the target under harmful effects.

effets.description: The target will receive 25% increased damage.
Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
effets.note: [Time of Destruction] will be decreased by 1 turn each whenever you attack the target under harmful effects.

competences.description: Creates a giant energy by destroying the HP of all Monsters on the battlefield, excluding yourself, by 15% each. Afterwards, attacks all enemies to inflict great damage in proportion to the destroyed HP and destroys the HP by 50% of the damage dealt.

effets.description: Attacks an additional time on the same turn.
